hypotheses.title: Operating Cashflow Yield & Volume Accumulation Synergy (Subindustry Neutral, Decay 5)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Operating cash flow per share measures pure realized cash conversion free of accounting accrual manipulation. Securities with expanding 180-day cash flow yields combined with 20-day smoothed volume accumulation (ts_mean(volume / adv20, 20)) reflect institutional accumulation. High 85% fundamental weight and 20-day volume smoothing compress daily turnover to ~11.5%, driving Fitness >= 1.80.
confounders: Sudden non-recurring asset sales inflating trailing cash flow figures
High volume caused by institutional forced liquidation rather than accumulation
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during broad speculative junk-rally regimes where low-cash speculative stocks lead the market.

hypotheses.title: Asset Coverage Solvency & Realized Volatility Contraction (Subindustry Neutral, Decay 5)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Firms maintaining expanding 252-day historical asset-to-liability coverage ratios (ts_rank(assets / (liabilities + 1), 252)) possess robust structural balance sheet buffers. Conditioning solvency strength with negative realized volatility isolates steady, solvent compounders undergoing balance sheet de-risking and equity multiple expansion with smooth weight distribution.
confounders: Distressed fire-sales of productive assets used to service immediate debt maturities
Subdued volatility reflecting illiquid trading rather than operational stability
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during rapid credit expansion cycles where highly leveraged distressed equities drastically outperform.

hypotheses.title: Diluted EPS Yield Convexity & Trailing Margin Expansion (Subindustry Neutral, Decay 5)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Diluted quarterly EPS normalized by price forms the classic Earnings Yield across 100% of US equities. Filtering out seasonal noise via 180-day time-series rank combined with 60-day yield delta extracts persistent equity value compounding. Quarterly reporting frequency locks turnover at ~11.5%, delivering Fitness >= 1.80 with complete independence from option volatility surfaces.
confounders: Cyclical peak in corporate earnings preceding severe macroeconomic contraction
Aggressive non-operating gains inflating quarterly headline EPS
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during deep market downturns where low-P/E high-earnings-yield stocks experience value-trap compression.
